When you lose an item on a bus on us.megabus.com, follow these steps according to Megabus:

1. Submit a Lost Item Inquiry:
   - Report the lost item to the Megabus lost and found department by filling out their inquiry form, accessible via the Help / Contact Us page (https://us.megabus.com/contact-us).
   - You can also contact customer support by emailing questions@us.megabus.com or by using the live chat feature with their virtual assistant (Chuck) on the Contact Us page, who can connect you with a customer service representative if needed.

2. Processing and Investigation:
   - Once submitted, your information is entered into their system for processing by the lost and found department.
   - The department responds to all loss inquiries, though responses may take several days while an investigation is conducted to locate the item. Megabus notes that they make every attempt to return items to their rightful owners and assist with retrieval.

3. Luggage Liability Limitations:

When you lose an item on a bus on us.megabus.com, follow these steps according to Megabus:

1. Submit a Lost Item Inquiry:
   - Report the lost item to the Megabus lost and found department by filling out their inquiry form, accessible via the Help / Contact Us page (https://us.megabus.com/contact-us).
   - You can also contact customer support by emailing questions@us.megabus.com or by using the live chat feature with their virtual assistant (Chuck) on the Contact Us page, who can connect you with a customer service representative if needed.

2. Processing and Investigation:
   - Once submitted, your information is entered into their system for processing by the lost and found department.
   - The department responds to all loss inquiries, though responses may take several days while an investigation is conducted to locate the item. Megabus notes that they make every attempt to return items to their rightful owners and assist with retrieval.

3. Luggage Liability Limitations:
   - In the case of lost or damaged luggage, Megabus notes that their maximum liability is up to US $250 per passenger, and reimbursement applies only in the event of negligence on Megabus's part.
